taglineZh: 从英雄区到定价的单页转化落地页模板
taglineEn: Single-page SaaS landing from hero to pricing
descZh: 把产品价值组织成英雄区、Logo 墙、特性卡、三步流程、定价与 FAQ 的单页落地页。适合产品上线初期需要一页讲清卖点并引导注册的场景。产出单文件 HTML 模板，含移动端断点、柔和渐变与滚动入场动画。
descEn: Organizes product value into a one-page landing with hero, logo wall, feature cards, a 3-step flow, pricing and FAQ. Use it when a new product needs one page that explains the pitch and drives signups. Outputs a single-file HTML template with mobile breakpoints, soft gradients and scroll-in animations.
outputZh: 单页 HTML 落地页模板
demoCaptionZh: 演示页是一个数据看板产品的落地页片段：英雄区、特性卡与可切换月付/年付的定价锚点。
demoCaptionEn: A landing fragment for an analytics product: hero, feature cards and a pricing anchor with a live monthly/yearly toggle.

taglineZh: 内容先定死再排版，三种形态可选的做 PPT 流程
taglineEn: Content-first slide pipeline with three output modes
descZh: 按采集、逐页稿、风格说明、制作、局部打磨五个阶段生产幻灯片，前两步确认后才进入排版，避免反复返工。适合把一堆资料整理成汇报、课件或演示文稿，可在 HTML Slides、整页图片、可编辑 PPTX 三种形态里选。产出逐页稿、风格说明与成品幻灯片。
descEn: Produces slides through five stages: gather, page script, style spec, build, polish, with confirmation gates before layout starts to cut rework. Use it to turn raw material into a report deck or courseware, choosing between HTML slides, full-page images or editable PPTX. Outputs the page script, style spec and finished deck.
outputZh: 逐页稿 + 风格说明 + 成品幻灯片
outputEn: Page script, style spec and finished deck
demoCaptionZh: 演示页展示一页咖啡店秋季上新的成品幻灯片，下方是可点击的五阶段流程条与各阶段过闸条件。
demoCaptionEn: A finished coffee-shop autumn menu slide above a clickable five-stage pipeline showing each gate condition.

taglineZh: 带投票栏和评论数的拟真 Reddit 帖子卡
taglineEn: Realistic Reddit post card with vote rail
descZh: 把一段故事、提问或段子渲染成拟真 Reddit 帖子卡，含左侧投票栏、子版块信息、评论数与分享行。用于视频叠加或社媒故事分享，推荐暗色主题，票数按 12.3k 格式化。产出单文件 HTML 卡片，图标全部内联 SVG，不用外链图片。
descEn: Renders a story, question or joke as a realistic Reddit post card with a vote rail, subreddit meta, comment count and action row. Built for video overlays or story sharing, dark mode recommended, counts formatted like 12.3k. Outputs a single-file HTML card with inline SVG icons and no external images.
outputZh: 单文件 HTML 帖子卡片
demoCaptionZh: 演示页是一条 r/webdev 英文示例帖：暗色卡片、可点击的上下投票栏与 1.2k 评论行。
demoCaptionEn: A sample r/webdev post in dark mode with a working up/down vote rail and a 1.2k comments row.

taglineZh: 专辑封面加进度条的正在播放风格卡片
taglineEn: Now-playing card with album art and progress
descZh: 把一首歌、一段播客或一段个人介绍渲染成 Spotify 正在播放风格卡片，含专辑封面、进度条、时间戳与播放控制行。适合视频叠加、个人主页或创作者 hero 区，封面用渐变与几何图形绘制。产出单文件 HTML，音波动效可随系统减少动画设置关闭。
descEn: Renders a song, podcast or personal intro as a Spotify now-playing style card with album art, progress bar, timestamps and playback controls. Fits video overlays, personal homepages or creator heroes; cover art is drawn with gradients and geometry. Outputs a single-file HTML whose equalizer motion respects reduced-motion settings.
outputZh: 单文件 HTML 播放卡片
demoCaptionZh: 演示页是一张 Lo-Fi 正在播放卡：内联 SVG 专辑封面、会走的进度条、可切歌的播放控制与音波动效。
demoCaptionEn: A lo-fi now-playing card: inline SVG cover art, a live progress bar, track-switching controls and an equalizer.

taglineZh: 带蓝勾和互动数据的高仿真 X 推文卡片
taglineEn: High-fidelity X post card with engagement stats
descZh: 把推文内容或一句金句渲染成高仿真 X 帖子卡，含头像、蓝勾、话题标签、回复转推点赞行与浏览量。用于视频叠加、图卡分享或知识沉淀，数字自动格式化为 1.2K 形式，内容必须来自用户输入。产出单文件 HTML，支持明暗两套主题。
descEn: Renders tweet content or a pull quote as a high-fidelity X post card with avatar, verified badge, hashtags, reply/repost/like row and view count. Built for video overlays, shareable image cards or note archives; numbers auto-format like 1.2K and content must come from the user. Outputs a single-file HTML in light or dark theme.
outputZh: 单文件 HTML 推文卡片
demoCaptionZh: 演示页是一条英文示例推文：暗色卡片、蓝勾认证、可点赞收藏的互动行与浏览量。
demoCaptionEn: A sample English tweet in dark mode: verified badge, working like/bookmark actions and a views row.

taglineZh: 极简预发布页，一个邮箱输入框攒早鸟用户
taglineEn: Minimal pre-launch page with email capture
descZh: 为还没上线的产品做一张极简等候页：居中 logo、一行 tagline、大字 hero、合并成 pill 的邮箱捕获框和三个小卖点。适合早鸟内测阶段收集意向用户，提交成功有对勾微动效。产出单页 HTML，含渐变 mesh、噪点纹理等装饰图层。
descEn: Builds a minimal pre-launch page for an unshipped product: centered logo, one-line tagline, big hero, a pill-shaped email capture and three small selling points. Use it during beta recruitment to collect intent; success shows a check micro-animation. Outputs a single-page HTML with gradient mesh and grain decoration layers.
demoCaptionZh: 演示页是一个离线笔记应用的预发布页：mesh 渐变背景与本地校验的邮箱捕获，提交后显示排位反馈。
demoCaptionEn: A pre-launch page for an offline notes app: mesh gradient backdrop and locally validated email capture with queue-position feedback.

taglineZh: 真源码至上的复刻决策树：侦察、定级、施工、替换
taglineEn: Source-first clone playbook: recon, grade, build, swap
descZh: 提供先拿真源码、再浏览器侦察、复杂度定级、搭工程、替换内容的网站复刻决策树，覆盖静态站、React/Vue/Next 内容站与 WebGL 重前端站三大分支。适合照着某个网站做本地学习版或还原其交互效果，强制核对 AI 二手分析里的可执行代码。产出侦察记录、复刻工程与审计报告。
descEn: A portable decision tree for cloning websites: get real source first, then browser recon, complexity grading, scaffolding and content swap, covering static sites, React/Vue/Next content sites and WebGL-heavy frontends. Use it to rebuild a site locally for study or reproduce its interactions, with mandatory verification of any AI-generated analysis code. Outputs recon records, the clone project and audit reports.
outputZh: 复刻工程 + 侦察与审计报告
outputEn: Clone project plus recon and audit reports
demoCaptionZh: 演示页是复刻对照示意：拖动分割线比较参考帧与还原帧，可开关差异标注，下方是五步决策树。
demoCaptionEn: A clone comparison mockup: drag the divider between reference and rebuilt frames, toggle diff annotations, and step through the decision tree.

taglineZh: 布局、字阶、配色、间距的 CSS 实现速查板
taglineEn: CSS patterns for layout, type, color and spacing
descZh: 汇总生产级界面的 CSS 实现模式：Grid 与 Flex 选型表、1.25 字阶、五角色配色、8px 间距 token、层级技巧与响应式断点策略。适合写界面代码时查阅具体取值与写法，与讲设计理论的 ui-design 互补。产出可直接套用的代码片段与 token 对照表。
descEn: Collects production-grade CSS implementation patterns: a Grid-vs-Flex selection table, a 1.25 type scale, five-role palettes, 8px spacing tokens, hierarchy techniques and breakpoint strategy. Use it while writing interface code to look up concrete values; it complements the theory-focused ui-design skill. Outputs ready-to-use code snippets and token tables.
outputZh: CSS 代码模式与 token 速查表
outputEn: CSS pattern snippets and token tables
demoCaptionZh: 演示页是一块模式示例板：可切换比例的字阶样张、4/8px 间距尺、角色色板与 Grid/Flex 迷你示例。
demoCaptionEn: A pattern board: type specimens with a live ratio switch, a 4/8px spacing ruler, role swatches and mini Grid/Flex demos.

taglineZh: 词典流水线加 RTL 与定高，切语言不跳版
taglineEn: Dictionary pipeline, RTL and fixed heights, no layout jump
descZh: 给已有双语前端站点扩到 5-8 种语言的落地手册：保住 l(en,zh) 签名只换实现，词典走抽取、机翻、校正三段流水线，逐个处理区块不更新、译文等于原文、变量句翻不了、首屏高度乱跳等七个真实的坑。含 RTL 取舍与金额本地化规则。产出词典工具链、定高与 fit-to-box 方案及四道验收清单。
descEn: A hands-on manual for expanding an existing bilingual frontend to 5-8 languages: keep the l(en,zh) signature and swap the implementation, run an extract-translate-review dictionary pipeline, and fix seven real pitfalls including stale modules, translations equal to source, variable sentences and jumping first-screen heights. Covers RTL trade-offs and currency localization. Outputs the dictionary toolchain, fixed-height and fit-to-box fixes, and a four-part acceptance checklist.
outputZh: i18n 改造手册 + 词典工具链
outputEn: i18n retrofit manual and dictionary toolchain
demoCaptionZh: 演示页是一个茶叶小店片段：中/英/阿拉伯语实时切换，阿语自动 RTL，首屏定高不跳版，金额保持拉丁数字。
demoCaptionEn: A tea-shop fragment switching live between Chinese, English and Arabic (RTL), with fixed hero height and Latin-digit prices.

taglineZh: 网格底、马克笔触、便利贴的草稿期线框
taglineEn: Lo-fi wireframes with grid paper and sticky notes
descZh: 画手绘风线框：方格纸背景、马克笔笔触、斜线填充的图表占位、微微旋转的黄色便利贴和多方案标签页。适合还在排信息层级、不希望别人误以为这是成品的早期探索阶段。产出单页 HTML 线框，字体与对齐刻意不规整；要可点击流程走 prototype-web。
descEn: Draws hand-sketched wireframes: graph-paper background, marker strokes, hatched chart placeholders, slightly rotated sticky notes and variant tabs. Use it during early information-hierarchy exploration when the artifact must not be mistaken for a finished design. Outputs a single-page HTML wireframe with deliberately loose type and alignment; clickable flows belong to prototype-web.
outputZh: 单页 HTML 手绘线框
demoCaptionZh: 演示页是一张方格纸上的首页线框草稿：方案 A/B 标签切换、斜线填充占位与可点按的便利贴批注。
demoCaptionEn: A homepage wireframe draft on graph paper: variant A/B tabs, hatched placeholders and tappable sticky-note annotations.
